# Velmora Bridge

The Velmora Bridge is a steel arch bridge over the river Osk in Harrow Vale.
It was completed in 1911 and has a main span of 412 metres.

## Design

The bridge was designed by the engineer Ilse Tarkand. Her design used a
two-hinged arch so that the deck could expand in summer without cracking.

## Later history

The deck was widened in 1958 to carry two tram lines. Trams stopped crossing
the bridge in 1974, and the tram lines were removed in 1976.
